# AI Tools NL - LLM-friendly site information

## Site
- Name: AI Tools NL
- URL: https://rigbay.github.io/dutch-ai-tools
- Language: nl-NL
- Type: AI/SaaS tool comparison and review site
- Technology: Astro 5.x + Tailwind CSS, static generation
- Sitemap: https://rigbay.github.io/dutch-ai-tools/sitemap-index.xml

## Content
- Articles: 126
- Categories: productiviteit, marketing, creatie, development, business, technologie
- Each article: comparison table of 5-8 tools, pros/cons, FAQ with Schema.org markup
- Target audience: Dutch entrepreneurs, freelancers, marketers, developers, content creators

## Monetization
- Affiliate links (marked) via SaaS referral/partner programs
- Providers: beehiiv, Taskade, Writesonic, and more
- No paid placements; rankings based on merit

## Navigation
- Homepage: lists latest articles and categories
- Category pages: /categorie/{productiviteit,marketing,creatie,development,business,technologie}/
- Individual articles: /{slug}/
- About: /over/
